title: Kitchen Etiquette
body:
## Fire hazard ⚠

- Always turn off the devices when not in use.

## Shock hazard ⚠

- If you spill something on the power cables, notify the Safety staff. Don't touch anything.

## Please…

- Leave the counters & sink tidy and clean.
- Scrape off or pour any leftovers before leaving your plates and glasses in the sink.
- Check the washing machine and if the contents are not clean, you may put your items inside. The washing machine is operated by the cleaning crew, twice a week.
- For any perishable food or drinks, use a marker and note the date opened near the expiry date.
- Mind your containers, throw away moldy stuff.
- Let the floor staff know if anything is missing.

title: How to Use the Monitors
body:
- When moving the monitor around, handle by the stand, not the monitor itself. Lock the wheels when in place.
- Before adjusting the height, make sure no cables are fixed with tape or wrapped around other parts.
- To adjust the height, hold ↑ ↓ together on the height controller until it unlocks and moves slightly. Then hold the respective button to adjust.
- Please be mindful of the remote; leave it on the monitor stand when not in use.
- Don't try to remove the monitor from the stand.

title: Studio Etiquette
subtitle: 1/2 – Be mindful ☺
body:
## Fire hazard ⚠

- Never leave heating elements plugged in.
- No open flame or candles are allowed.
- No smoking, no vaping.

## Shock hazard ⚠

- No liquids and drinks anywhere near power extensions or plugged devices.
- Don't use torn cables or damaged chargers.

## Movable objects

- Don't push around the partitions without staff support. Don't climb on the partitions.
- Don't stand on desks or chairs. Only use ladders or steps with staff support.
- Don't block the exits or fire extinguishers.
- Don't bring in found objects, wood or soil.
- Please be mindful of your personal items.

title: How to Use the Printer
subtitle: 2/2 Printing documents
body:
1. Send an email to **print@printbyxerox.com** from your registered email address and attach the document(s) you want to print (PDF, Word, …).
2. Wait for a confirmation email from Xerox stating that all submitted documents were accepted.
3. Go to the printer and tap the **@PrintByXerox** icon.
4. Enter your email address.
5. Enter your password (either the original Xerox password or the one you reset).
6. Wait a moment for your uploaded documents to appear.
7. Adjust any print settings as needed: one-sided or two-sided, paper size, other available options.
8. Press **Print**.
